title: GATX Corporation Reports 2026 Second-Quarter Results
summary: Company raises 2026 full-year earnings guidance to $9.90–$10.30 per diluted share Rail North America's utilization for the combined fleet remains high at 98.0% at quarter end Demand for aircraft spare engines remains strong Investment volume was $200.5 million in the second quarter and totaled $4.7 billion year to date GATX Corporation (NYSE: GATX) today reported 2026 second-quarter net income attributable to GATX of $103.4 million, or $2.84 per diluted share, compared to net income attributable to GATX of $75.5 million, or $2.06 per diluted share, in the second quarter of 2025. Net income attributable to GATX for the first six months of 2026 was $188.9 million, or $5.19 per diluted share, compared to $154.1 million, or $4.21 per diluted share, in the prior year period. "GATX delivered strong second-quarter results," said Robert C. Lyons, president and chief executive officer of GATX. "At Rail North America, fleet demand remained stable for most car types.
